title: Stable influence
statement: For $\rho\in\mathbb{R}$, a real-valued function $f$ on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube, and a coordinate $i\in[n]$, its stable influence at $i$ is $\sum_{S\subseteq[n]: i\in S}\rho^{|S|-1}\widehat f(S)^2$.
